ghiChu: SUA MOT BAO DONG GIA. Ban 1.17.x cai len may trang chay DUNG, nhung phep tu kiem cuoi bo cai bao "CAI DAT CHUA DUNG - 2/10 phep kiem bi TRUOT" va dan "Dung mo cua ban bang ban cai nay". Hai phep truot deu la "0 phong" - ma 0 phong CHINH LA thu LUAT 118 co y lam ra: may moi cai len trang, chu quan tu khai phong. Phep kiem ay viet cho thoi bo cai tu gieo 10 phong mau, va khong ai sua theo. Nay no hoi dung cau: bang phong CO DOC DUOC khong (doc ra so 0 van la bang co that), va phan biet duoc "doc duoc, ra 0" voi "goi hong". Rieng lan CAP NHAT de len du lieu dang co thi van doi phong phai con - cap nhat ma phong bien mat la mat du lieu that. Mot phep kiem bao dong gia con nguy hiem hon khong co phep kiem nao: lan sau no keu that thi khong ai tin nua. Khong them ban di tru.
